Small fixup on tools/projects.mjs, function acquireRegistryLock ONLY. The two catch blocks inside its retry loop (the stale-lock reclaim catch with comment /* another writer won */ and the stat catch with comment /* gone */) currently console.error any non-ENOENT error on EVERY loop iteration. The loop retries every 25ms for up to 10s, so a persistent error (EACCES/EPERM) would print ~400 lines.

Change: declare `let loggedRetryError = false;` once, right before the `for (;;)` loop. In each of those two catches, keep the exact same ENOENT check and message, but only call console.error when `!loggedRetryError`, then set `loggedRetryError = true`. One shared flag for both catches. Keep the comments. Change nothing else at all: same control flow, timing, throws, returns; do not touch any other catch or function. No unused bindings, no `void error`.

Then run: node --test tests/registry-review.test.mjs tests/registry-round2.test.mjs tests/registry-round3.test.mjs tests/board-projects-filter.test.mjs and confirm green.
